checks.what: Three independent audits read all 1130 cards against the GitHub Docs pages they quote, found word for word by the card checker, including every YAML, CLI and API snippet and both figures
checks.result: No wrong answers. Ten ambiguous cards rewritten, among them a scenario whose keyed answer described an organisation owner who could not exist and cards that treated conflicting Docs pages as settled; 3 unsupported claims, 5 unclear cards and 13 minor issues also fixed.
